old_caption: The video depicts a close-up view of two hands manipulating a cylindrical object against a plain white background. The object appears to be a tool or instrument with a metallic shaft and a black handle. Initially, one hand holds the handle while the other hand grasps the opposite end of the shaft. The hands then rotate the object, revealing its full length and design. The metallic shaft is smooth and reflective, while the handle has a textured grip for better handling. The hands continue to adjust their grip and position, demonstrating the object's flexibility and functionality. The video focuses on the interaction between the hands and the tool, highlighting its features and potential uses. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the background remains consistently white throughout the sequence.

caption: The video depicts two hands over a white surface working with a silver rod, a black ring, and a black cylinder. The left hand grips the cylinder, whose upper end has a through-hole, while its index finger rests on the ring around the rod. The right hand pinches the rod's far end, and a small beige bead sits out of focus behind the left hand. The ring slides toward the right hand, so the rod's left tip emerges beyond it and the stub lengthens. The left index finger lifts away as the rod tilts into a steeper diagonal with its left end raised. The ring continues until it reaches the right-hand grip, where the fingers hide it. Meanwhile the left hand rotates the cylinder so its hole faces the rod's left tip. The rod's left tip aligns with and approaches that hole, the right hand still holding the rod's far end.
